LanguageData.SSC_Surgery_BeautyEnhancement.label: cosmetic reshaping surgery
LanguageData.SSC_Surgery_BeautyEnhancement.descriptio: Reshape an adult humanlike flesh pawn with regular PNA. Each success raises vanilla Beauty by one step, up to Beautiful (+2). Existing higher Beauty, conflicts, unsupported trait sources or recovery prevent treatment. Requires a free adult colonist with Medical 8. Uses 10 regular PNA and 3 industrial or glitterworld medicine, including anesthesia. Vanilla surgeon, medicine, bed, room and inspiration factors determine success, capped at 98%. Success/failure causes reaction severity 0.05/0.25, fading by 0.10 per day. Failure adds no surgical injuries; anesthesia, interruption and supplies follow vanilla surgery.
